To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) NADK expression and activity are essential for the maintenance of the NADP pool and (ii) NADK is a critical factor for the redox state in human cells, as its expression controls the cellular NADPH concentration.
NAD kinases control the NADPH/NADP+ ratio in human cells, and the Nrf2 and peroxiredoxins are sensitive to changes in the NADP redox state.
the human NADK is a cytosolic protein that controls the intracellular concentration of NADPH and that the NADPH is an important transmitter of oxidative stress in human cells.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the regulation of the NADP pool and the impact of this regulation on cellular defense systems against reactive oxygen species.
the regulation of NADPH levels in human cells and the physiological role of NAD kinases in this context.
the identification and analysis of a novel mechanism of the control of the NADP pool size, which may also be of interest for the understanding of cancer cell physiology.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the NADP/NADPH ratio in cells is a major redox signal that is controlled by the NADK level.
the NADPH levels in human cells are controlled primarily by the NADK activity and that the NADP redox state is a major determinant of the oxidative stress response in these cells.
the NADPH/NADP+ ratio is a major redox signal in human cells, but that it can only be regulated by NADK in a limited range.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
NADK is the major determinant of the cellular NADPH concentration, but not the sole one.
the NADPH/NADP+ ratio is a critical determinant for cellular redox homeostasis, which is controlled primarily by NADP-dependent oxidoreductases, but not by the NADK level.
the NADPH/NADP+ ratio is a major regulator of the redox state in human cells.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the NADPH/NADP+ ratio, rather than the absolute concentration of NADPH, is critical for cell physiology.
NADK controls the NADPH pool in human cells and that this pool can be shifted by a few-fold without affecting the redox state.
NADK is a key enzyme for the control of the cellular NADPH level, and that the NADPH/NADP+ redox state is a major transmitter of oxidant stress in human cells.
